capabilities.description: Inspect accessible workflows, executions, projects, folders, tags, credential metadata, node references, Data Tables, Agents, instance activity, and saved preferences.

Create, change, publish, archive, test, and execute workflows; manage folders and Data Tables; build, publish, and run Agents; and install verified community nodes. Write access includes the read scopes required to make safe changes.

description: Use the UC San Diego n8n instance through its user-scoped remote MCP server.
